item.title: Senate Democrats Have Announced That They Will Block Funding For ICE This Week
item.description: Senate Democrats, including those who voted to end the government shutdown, have announced that they will not support any funding for ICE after another American was gunned down in Minnesota.

item.title: CNN Destroys The Trump Administration Lies About The Killing Of Alex Pretti
item.description: CNN and Dana Bash did some great work confronting Trump Border Patrol Commander Greg Bovino with video evidence and challenging the administration lies about the killing of Alex Pretti.

item.title: Trump Melts Down Over Ballroom Lawsuit As Americans Get Murdered In The Streets
item.description: The self-described "law and order president" is spending his day melting down over the White House ballroom lawsuit as his administration murders people in the country's streets.

item.title: Karoline Leavitt Blames Democrats For The Trump Administration Murder Of Alex Pretti
item.description: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt said that Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey and Gov. Tim Walz were to blame for Trump border patrol agents murdering Alex Pretti

item.title: The Alex Pretti Killing Has Republicans Abandoning Trump
item.description: The Alex Pretti killing has caused several Senate Republicans to not buy what the Trump administration is selling and call for an independent investigation.

item.title: Trump Tried To Cover Up Alex Pretti's Death And It Was A Disaster
item.description: Donald Trump said that he will be overseeing the investigation into Alex Pretti's death, but he already claimed the killing was justified, so his cover up is already a disaster.

item.title: Democrats Tell Trump To Fire Kristi Noem Immediately Or Impeachment Proceedings Will Begin
item.description: House Democratic told Donald Trump that he must fire Kristi Noem immediately, or they will begin impeachment proceedings against her.

item.title: New Bombshell Leak From Trump White House Could Be The End For Stephen Miller
item.description: The White House seems to be turning on each other and throwing people under the bus. A new leak from the administration claims that Stephen Miller was the source of the Alex Pretti misinformation.

item.title: How Democrats Can Force The Impeachment Of Kristi Noem
item.description: House Democrats are in the minority, but Hakeem Jeffries has a plan to force an impeachment vote on Kristi Noem.

item.title: Democrats Plan To Mass Fire Trump's ICE Agents
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy (D-CT) said that when Democrats take back power and control the White House, they are going to gut ICE and fire thousands of Trump's unqualified ICE agents.
